description: Luxury Menswear Fashion Platform with 3D WebGL Showroom, E-Commerce, Admin Panel, and GEO/SEO readiness

userStories.title: Foundation & Design System Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a Next.js project with Tailwind CSS, custom burgundy color tokens, and Lucide icons.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind config includes burgundy, crimson, espresso, warm ivory, and champagne gold tokens
Global styles and typography hierarchy established
userStories.notes: Configured Tailwind with brand palette: Deep Burgundy #4A1216, Crimson #6B1D24, Dark Espresso #2B080A, Warm Ivory #F9F6F4, Accent Gold #C5A880. Playfair Display and Plus Jakarta Sans loaded.

userStories.title: Core Data Models & Store State
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want persistent cart, wishlist, products, and orders state.
acceptanceCriteria: StoreContext handles cart, wishlist, products, promo codes, and orders with localStorage persistence
userStories.notes: StoreContext and store types implemented with localStorage sync, coupon system (TREND10, VIP20), and product catalog.

userStories.title: Navigation & Responsive Header with Centered Logo
userStories.description: As a user, I want a luxury header with centered Trend Street logo, navigation links, and cart drawer.
acceptanceCriteria: Logo centered in desktop and mobile header
Cart drawer slides over with item count badge
userStories.notes: Trend Street logo centered across all viewports with ornate monogram emblem, slide-over cart drawer, and mobile menu.

userStories.title: 3D WebGL Luxury Garment Showroom
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want an interactive 3D WebGL fabric and garment showroom on the home page.
acceptanceCriteria: Three.js canvas renders interactive 3D luxury fabric mesh with orbit and swatch switcher
Device pixel ratio capped at 2 for smooth 60fps performance
userStories.notes: HeroShowroom3D implemented with Three.js drape wave physics, interactive lighting, fabric swatch switcher, and 60fps capped DPR.

userStories.title: Public Storefront Pages (Home, Shop, Product, Lookbook, About)
userStories.description: As a menswear customer, I want dedicated pages for browsing, product discovery, lookbook, and brand story.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page renders hero, curated collections, trending products, and reviews
Shop catalog provides multi-filter sidebar and sorting
Product detail page features gallery, size guide modal, and accordion details
Lookbook page features interactive shop the look hotspots
About page details brand heritage and fabric mills
userStories.notes: All 5 storefront views built with rich editorial styling, interactive hotspot pins, Suspense boundaries, and size guide modal.

userStories.title: Cart, Checkout Flow & Order Confirmation
userStories.description: As a customer, I want a seamless bag and checkout experience with immediate order confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Bag page with promo code engine (TREND10)
Multi-step checkout with address inputs and payment simulation
Order confirmation page with generated tracking ID
userStories.notes: End-to-end purchasing journey completed: Bag -> Checkout (Cards, UPI, COD, Netbanking) -> Order Confirmation receipt.

userStories.title: Saved Items & Customer Profile
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to manage saved items and view profile order history.
acceptanceCriteria: Saved items page with move-to-bag action
Profile page with VIP gold tier and order history tracking timeline
userStories.notes: Saved items page with instant add-to-bag and customer profile with bespoke measurements editor and order history.

userStories.title: Admin Panel & Privileged Access Register
userStories.description: As admin Sujal, I want to manage products, orders, and review the access register.
acceptanceCriteria: Products CRUD (add, edit, delete, in-line stock)
userStories.notes: Complete administrative control room with privileged access register (CSV, JSON, SQL DDL export), product inventory CRUD, and order status fulfillment.

userStories.title: Digital Marketing, SEO & GEO Optimization
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap.ts, and JSON-LD schema for AI & search visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: robots.txt configured for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot
JSON-LD structured data for Store and Products
userStories.notes: Comprehensive SEO and GEO setup: robots.txt, llms.txt with 134-167 word passage citability, dynamic sitemap.ts, and JSON-LD schema.

userStories.title: Defensive Security, IP Rate Limiter & Webhook Verification
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I want IP sliding-window rate limiting on login and constant-time webhook verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Sliding-window rate limiter prevents brute-force login
Constant-time signature verification prevents timing attacks
userStories.notes: Implemented sliding-window rate limiter, constant-time HMAC check in payment webhook, and 10,000-event deduplication cache.

userStories.title: India-First Logistics, 6-Digit PIN Engine & INR Currency
userStories.description: As an Indian shopper, I want prices in INR, all-inclusive 12% GST, and live PIN code delivery estimates.
acceptanceCriteria: PIN code validation for 6-digit Indian postal codes
Blue Dart Apex & Delhivery Air transit SLAs
Integer minor units in paise with en-IN formatting
userStories.notes: Pincode engine with circle mapping and Blue Dart/Delhivery transit estimation, paise pricing engine, and ₹1,999 free shipping threshold.

userStories.title: High-Converting Indian D2C Checkout
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want to checkout with Indian address format, UPI, Cards, Net Banking, and COD.
acceptanceCriteria: UPI, RuPay, Net Banking, and COD options
userStories.notes: High-converting checkout with live PIN serviceability check, UPI apps/QR, Indian banks, and server-side pricing validation.

userStories.title: Statutory Indian Legal Compliance Pages
userStories.description: As a consumer, I want access to statutory Indian e-commerce policies and Grievance Officer details.
userStories.notes: 5 statutory pages implemented with active footer links, 30-day doorstep return protocol, and Grievance Officer Rohan Kulkarni details.

userStories.title: Automated Testing Suite & Code Review Quality Gates
userStories.description: As a release manager, I want 100% automated test coverage on security, pricing, and logistics.
userStories.notes: 15 unit tests passing covering authentication, paise calculations, shipping waivers, and PIN validation; 27/27 routes compiled cleanly.
